header.title: P.Leid.Inst. 1 8: Concordance to the Sortes of Astrampsychus with list of gods: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Greek magical papyri and amulets
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:magic:dclp:59318:grc, from papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (CC BY 3.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY 4.0: credit papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (the source's own licence is CC BY 3.0) and this AI translation.

notes.1.4: The numbers are Greek numerals. The Greek names are Ischys (Strength), Agathos Daimon (Good Spirit), Ge (Earth) and Astrape (Lightning).
